name: Long-Form Media Transcription, Alignment & Caption Projection Profile
required_stages: forced alignment when provider-native timing is absent or insufficient
optional translation with source/target language provenance
invariants: Source separation is optional preprocessing and is never STT authority.
STT must remain executable with source separation disabled.
Requested preprocessing failures must fail closed; silent fallback is forbidden.
Timeline offsets and timebase must be explicit and preserved through subtitle projection.
Diarization is optional but, when requested, speaker-turn evidence must be preserved.
Forced alignment is a distinct typed artifact and cannot silently overwrite provider-native timing.
Translation is optional and must preserve source text, source language, target language, provider identity and lineage.
Caption QC evidence is required before production subtitle/timeline projection is promoted.
